title: Class II food recall: Little Temptations, Chocolatey Eyeballs (Hazelnut Praline Chocolatey Eyeballs ) Spooks
summary: Product packaging mix-up. Product containing whey (milk), were distributed in packaging that did not reveal the presence of milk.
place: AZ, TX, VA, GA, MA, NC, IN, NV, CA, NJ, CT, OH, WY
